map.：算法：正 n 边形每个内角 θ=(n−2)·180°/n，内角和=(n−2)·: Algorithm: each interior angle of a regular n-gon is theta = (n-2) x 180 degrees / n, and the angle sum is (n-2) x 180 degrees. n must be an integer at or above 3; the more sides, the closer the angle is to 180 degrees.
map.：例：正六边形 n=6 → 内角=(6−2)·180/6=120.00°、内角和: Example: a regular hexagon n=6 gives interior angle (6-2) x 180/6 = 120.00 degrees with an angle sum of 720 degrees (6 x 120). A regular octagon n=8 gives 135.00 degrees with a sum of 1080 degrees; a triangle n=3 gives 60.00 degrees.

map.从一顶点把正 n 边形分成 n−2 个三角形，每个内角和 180°，故内角和=(: From one vertex a regular n-gon splits into n-2 triangles, each with interior angles summing to 180 degrees, so the interior angle sum is (n-2) x 180 degrees; a regular polygon has equal angles, so dividing by n gives each interior angle.
map.内角能超过 180° 吗？: Can an Interior Angle Exceed 180 Degrees?
map.正（凸）多边形内角恒 <180°，n→∞ 时趋近 180°（逼近圆）。内角 ≥1: For a regular (convex) polygon the interior angle is always below 180 degrees and approaches 180 degrees as n goes to infinity (approaching a circle). Interior angles of 180 degrees or more belong to concave or star polygons, and this formula does not apply.
